activity_summary: You left before the children woke. Anne stood in the door, as she does, and did not ask her question. You did not pack the bags again. You said the bay had had eleven days' grass and was no sweeter, and that her knot would be retied as she had tied it. You said the tables would take nothing today.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Accepted the blank day and did not go up.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood in the door, kept the question unasked, and named her own knot.

entities.name: the bay
entities.context: Mentioned in She is in the door

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am in the door. That is the whole of the seeing-off.

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will be in the door until the lane hides thee. Write nothing.
